# INX Social

INX Social is a browser-based Facebook Page and Reels scheduling product operated by INAXX LTD.

Canonical website: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/
Product: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/#product
Features: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/#features
Workflow: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/#workflow
Pricing: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/#pricing
Privacy: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/privacy.html
Terms: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/terms.html
Data deletion: https://social.inaxx.co.uk/data-deletion.html

Public product facts must be taken from the canonical landing and legal pages. Private Studio, portal, admin and API routes are not public documentation and are excluded from search indexing.
